report: The three neighbors reached an agreement on sharing the cargo trailer. A uses it Fridays through Sundays; C uses it Mondays through Thursdays. Each claims specific date ranges on a shared booking list, first come first served, and C will send his weekday ranges once his project dates are fixed. Each user gives B at least 48 hours notice before pickup, and handoffs happen at an agreed spot rather than at B's place. The trailer will not return to B's gravel pad after use; B will confirm with her landlord and C is checking whether his place can serve as storage, so final storage remains open. All three confirmed the plan verbally through me; no one raised further objections.
